messages:
Rae: Heads up : Prospect Hemlock Health dropped their vendor pack (includes SIG/CAIQ snippets + a short vendor questionnaire). They want SOC2 evidence, BYOK details, EU data residency confirmation, and clarification on transient prompt logging. PDF: https://drive.example/hemlock-pack.pdf

Diego: I can handle staging/POC provisioning and the infra Qs. @Noor can you take controls + SOC2?

Noor: I can do the security answers. Quick Q: is the POC intended to run in Hosted or Dedicated? BYOK is only available for Dedicated/Private.

Rae: Customer said BYOK required and EU residency preferred. Also asked: "Do you store prompts? Where and for how long?" They'd like a single named contact for follow-ups.

Tess: If any PHI, legal will need DPIA and DPA review. Rae, confirm whether data will be de-identified.

ticket-bot: Intake logged  ticket HH-2026-501. Status: open. Owner: unassigned.

Noor: Short answers we can give now: - Default input/log retention: 30 days (configurable per-customer). - Hosted: no customer-managed KMS; Dedicated/Private: BYOK via AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault, GCP CMEK and HSM options. - EU residency: Dedicated/VPC Private support EU-region deployment. Tess: will need to confirm DPA language for any PHI.

Diego: For POC we can spin up a Dedicated trial (1x A10G)  provision ~48 hours after approval. Staging SSO options: OIDC/SAML. Example Okta snippet:

```yaml
sso:
  provider: okta
  flow: oidc
  redirect: https://staging.hemlock.example/callback
```

Diego: I'll ping infra to validate partner-managed KMS flows for the account.

ticket-bot: Ticket HH-2026-501 owner updated: Noor, Diego. Status: in_progress.

Noor: Action items: 1) I'll draft control responses + attach SOC2 summary in ~3 business days. 2) Diego/infra to confirm BYOK integration checklist and EU region deployment ETA (1-2 business days). 3) Tess/legal to standby for DPIA if PHI surfaces.

Rae: Can we target draft answers in 4 business days? Customer is pushing for a quick turnaround. I'll be the named contact unless someone else wants it.

Tess: If PHI is confirmed, DPIA may add 5-7 business days. Flagging as potential timeline risk.

Noor: Agreed. Dedicated path keeps us to ~4 days. Full Hosted CAIQ mapping would be longer (10+ business days). Noted.

Diego: I'll follow up with infra now and update ticket with BYOK notes. Rae: please confirm whether POC will include any PHI by EOD so we can lock timelines.

Rae: Will confirm with Hemlock and update this thread. Thanks team :thumbsup:
